product.description: Upgrade your laptop connectivity with the Type-C 8-in-1 USB-C Hub. This multiport adapter lets you connect multiple devices and accessories through a single USB-C port. It gives you 4K UHD HDMI output for external displays, USB-C Power Delivery (PD) charging, USB 3.0 ports for fast data transfer, an RJ45 Ethernet port for wired internet, and SD and TF card readers, in a compact, portable and stylish design. It is plug-and-play. Best for laptops, MacBooks and other USB-C devices that support video output and USB-C hub functionality. Send us your device model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm it will work before you order.

faqs.question: Will this hub work with my laptop?
faqs.answer: It suits laptops, MacBooks and other USB-C devices that support video output and USB-C hub functionality. Send us your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: What ports does it have?
faqs.answer: It has 4K UHD HDMI, USB 3.0, an RJ45 Ethernet port, SD and TF card readers, and USB-C Power Delivery (PD) charging.

faqs.question: Can I charge my laptop through it?
